nodes.en: 【1】Figure 11.6【/1】 Progression of values in XY after each level of additions in the reverse tree.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 11.6【/1】 反向树中每层加法之后 XY 中值的演进。

nodes.en: The need for additional input element values is indicated by the shade of each cell in 【1】Fig. 11.6【/1】: White means that the position needs to accumulate partial sums from three other positions, light gray means 2, dark gray means 1, and black means 0. For example, initially, XY[14] is marked white because it has only the value of 【2】x【/2】【3】14【/3】 at the end of the reduction tree phase and needs to accumulate the partial sums from XY[7] (【4】x【/4】【5】0【/5】…【6】x【/6】【7】7【/7】), XY[11] (【8】x【/8】【9】8【/9】…【10】x【/10】【11】11【/11】), and XY[13] (【12】x【/12】【13】12【/13】…【14】x【/14】【15】13【/15】) to complete its final scan value (【16】x【/16】【17】0【/17】…【18】x【/18】【19】14【/19】). The reader should verify that because of the structure of the reduction tree, the XY positions for an input of size 【20】N【/20】 elements will never need the accumulation from more than log【21】2【/21】(【22】N【/22】)−1 partial sums from other XY positions. Furthermore, these partial sum positions will always be 1, 2, 4, … (powers of 2) away from each other. In our example, XY[14] needs log【23】2【/23】(16)−1=3 partial sums from positions that are 1 (between XY[14] and XY[13]), 2 (between XY[13] and XY[11]), and 4 (between XY[11] and XY[7]).
nodes.zh: 对额外输入元素值的需求在【1】图 11.6【/1】中用每个单元格的深浅表示：白色表示该位置需要从另外三个位置累加部分和，浅灰色表示 2 个，深灰色表示 1 个，黑色表示 0 个。例如，初始时 XY[14] 被标记为白色，因为在归约树阶段结束时它只有【2】x【/2】【3】14【/3】这一个值，它需要累加来自 XY[7]（【4】x【/4】【5】0【/5】…【6】x【/6】【7】7【/7】）、XY[11]（【8】x【/8】【9】8【/9】…【10】x【/10】【11】11【/11】）和 XY[13]（【12】x【/12】【13】12【/13】…【14】x【/14】【15】13【/15】）的部分和，才能完成其最终扫描值（【16】x【/16】【17】0【/17】…【18】x【/18】【19】14【/19】）。读者可以验证：由于归约树的结构，对于包含【20】N【/20】个元素的输入，XY 各位置需要的来自其他 XY 位置的部分和从不超过 log【21】2【/21】(【22】N【/22】)−1 个。此外，这些部分和位置之间总是相距 1、2、4、…（2 的幂）。在我们的例子中，XY[14] 需要 log【23】2【/23】(16)−1=3 个部分和，它们来自相距 1（XY[14] 与 XY[13] 之间）、2（XY[13] 与 XY[11] 之间）和 4（XY[11] 与 XY[7] 之间）的位置。

nodes.en: To organize our second half of the addition operations, we will first show all the operations that need partial sums from four positions away, then two positions away, then one position away. During the first level of the reverse tree, we add XY[7] to XY[11], which brings XY[11] to the final answer. In 【1】Fig. 11.6【/1】, position 11 is the only one that advances to its final answer. During the second level, we complete XY[5], XY[9], and XY[13], which can be completed with the partial sums that are two positions away: XY[3], XY[7], and XY[11], respectively. Finally, during the third level, we complete all even positions XY[2], XY[4], XY[6], XY[8], XY[10], and XY[12] by accumulating the partial sums that are one position away (immediate left neighbor of each position).
nodes.zh: 为了组织后半部分的加法运算，我们首先展示所有需要来自相距四个位置的部分和的运算，然后是相距两个位置的，最后是相距一个位置的。在反向树的第一层，我们把 XY[7] 加到 XY[11] 上，使 XY[11] 达到最终答案。在【1】图 11.6【/1】中，位置 11 是唯一推进到最终答案的位置。在第二层，我们完成 XY[5]、XY[9] 和 XY[13]，它们可以由相距两个位置的部分和（分别为 XY[3]、XY[7] 和 XY[11]）来完成。最后，在第三层，我们通过累加相距一个位置（各位置的直接左邻）的部分和，完成所有偶数位置 XY[2]、XY[4]、XY[6]、XY[8]、XY[10] 和 XY[12]。

nodes.en: We are now ready to implement the Brent-Kung approach to scan. We could implement the reduction tree phase of the parallel scan using the following loop:
nodes.zh: 现在我们准备实现 Brent-Kung 扫描方法。我们可以用下面的循环来实现并行扫描的归约树阶段：

nodes.en: Note that this loop is similar to the reduction in 【1】Fig. 10.6【/1】. There are only two differences. The first difference is that we accumulate the sum value toward the highest position, which is 【2】XY[blockDim.x-1]【/2】, rather than XY[0]. This is because the final result of the highest position is the total sum. For this reason, each active thread reaches for a partial sum to its left by subtracting the stride value from its index. The second difference is that we want the active threads to have a thread index of the form 2【3】【4】n【/4】【/3】−1 rather than 2【5】【6】n【/6】【/5】. This is why we add 1 to the threadIdx.x before the modulo (%) operation when we select the threads for performing addition in each iteration.
nodes.zh: 请注意，这个循环与【1】图 10.6【/1】中的归约类似，只有两点不同。第一点不同：我们把和值累加到最高的位置，即【2】XY[blockDim.x-1]【/2】，而不是 XY[0]。这是因为最高位置的最终结果就是总和。为此，每个活跃线程从自己的索引减去步长值，取得左侧的部分和。第二点不同：我们希望活跃线程的线程索引形如 2【3】【4】n【/4】【/3】−1，而不是 2【5】【6】n【/6】【/5】。这就是为什么在每次迭代选择执行加法的线程时，要先给 threadIdx.x 加 1，再做取模（%）运算。

nodes.en: One drawback of this style of reduction is that it has significant control divergence problems. As we saw in 【1】Chapter 10【/1】, Reduction and Minimizing Divergence, a better way is to use a decreasing number of contiguous threads to perform the additions as the loop advances. Unfortunately, the technique we used to reduce divergence in 【2】Fig. 10.8【/2】 cannot be used in the scan reduction tree phase, since it does not generate the needed partial sum values in the intermediate XY positions. Therefore we resort to a more sophisticated thread index to data index mapping that maps a continuous section of threads to a series of data positions that are of stride distance apart. The following code does so by mapping a continuous section of threads to the XY positions whose indices are of the form 【3】k【/3】*2【4】【5】n【/5】【/4】−1:
nodes.zh: 这种归约风格的一个缺点是它存在严重的控制发散问题。正如我们在【1】第 10 章【/1】归约：最小化发散中所见，更好的做法是随着循环推进使用数量不断减少的连续线程来执行加法。遗憾的是，我们在【2】图 10.8【/2】中用来减少发散的技术不能用于扫描归约树阶段，因为它不会在中间的 XY 位置生成所需的部分和值。因此，我们求助于一种更精巧的线程索引到数据索引的映射，把连续的一段线程映射到一系列彼此相距一个步长的数据位置。下面的代码就是这样做的：把连续的一段线程映射到下标形如【3】k【/3】*2【4】【5】n【/5】【/4】−1 的 XY 位置：

nodes.en: By using such a complex index calculation in each iteration of the for-loop, a contiguous set of threads starting from thread 0 will be used in every iteration to avoid control divergence within warps. In our small example in 【1】Fig. 11.5【/1】, there are 16 threads in the block. In the first iteration, stride is equal to 1. The first eight consecutive threads in the block will satisfy the if-condition. The XY index values calculated for these threads will be 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, and 15. These threads will perform the first row of additions in 【2】Fig. 11.5【/2】. In the second iteration, stride is equal to 2. Only the first four threads in the block will satisfy the if-condition. The index values calculated for these threads will be 3, 7, 11, and 15. These threads will perform the second row of additions in 【3】Fig. 11.5【/3】. Note that since each iteration will always be using consecutive threads, the control divergence problem does not arise until the number of active threads drops below the warp size.
nodes.zh: 通过在 for 循环的每次迭代中使用这种复杂的索引计算，每次迭代都会用到从线程 0 开始的一组连续线程，从而避免线程束内的控制发散。在我们【1】图 11.5【/1】的小例子中，线程块内有 16 个线程。第一次迭代时，步长等于 1。线程块中前八个连续线程满足 if 条件。为这些线程计算出的 XY 索引值分别是 1、3、5、7、9、11、13 和 15。这些线程将执行【2】图 11.5【/2】中第一行加法。第二次迭代时，步长等于 2。只有线程块中前四个线程满足 if 条件。为这些线程计算出的索引值分别是 3、7、11 和 15。这些线程将执行【3】图 11.5【/3】中第二行加法。请注意，由于每次迭代总是使用连续线程，在活跃线程数降到线程束大小以下之前，不会出现控制发散问题。

nodes.en: The reverse tree is a little more complex to implement. We see that the stride value decreases from 【1】SECTION_SIZE【/1】/4 to 1. In each iteration we need to “push” the value of XY elements from positions that are multiples of twice the stride value minus 1 to the right by stride positions. For example, in 【2】Fig. 11.5【/2】 the stride value decreases from 4 (2【3】2【/3】) down to 1. In the first iteration we would like to push (add) the value of XY[7] into XY[11], where 7 is 2*2【4】2【/4】−1 and distance (stride) is 2【5】2【/5】. Note that only thread 0 will be used for this iteration, since the index calculated for other threads will be too large to satisfy the if-condition. In the second iteration we push the values of XY[3], XY[7], and XY[11] to XY[5], XY[9], and XY[13], respectively. The indices 3, 7, and 11 are 1*2*2【6】1【/6】−1, 2*2*2【7】1【/7】−1, and 3*2*2【8】1【/8】−1, respectively. The destination positions are 2【9】1【/9】 positions away from the source positions. Finally, in the third iteration we push the values at all the odd positions to their even position right-hand neighbor (stride=2°).
nodes.zh: 反向树的实现稍微复杂一些。我们看到步长值从【1】SECTION_SIZE【/1】/4 递减到 1。每次迭代中，我们需要把某些 XY 元素的值从“两倍步长值减 1”的倍数位置“推送”到右侧相距一个步长的位置。例如，在【2】图 11.5【/2】中，步长值从 4（2【3】2【/3】）递减到 1。第一次迭代中，我们希望把 XY[7] 的值推送（相加）到 XY[11]，其中 7 是 2*2【4】2【/4】−1，距离（步长）为 2【5】2【/5】。请注意，这次迭代只使用线程 0，因为为其他线程计算出的索引太大，无法满足 if 条件。第二次迭代中，我们分别把 XY[3]、XY[7] 和 XY[11] 的值推送到 XY[5]、XY[9] 和 XY[13]。索引 3、7 和 11 分别是 1*2*2【6】1【/6】−1、2*2*2【7】1【/7】−1 和 3*2*2【8】1【/8】−1。目标位置距离源位置 2【9】1【/9】 个位置。最后，在第三次迭代中，我们把所有奇数位置的值推送到它们右侧的偶数位置（步长=2°）。

nodes.en: On the basis of the discussions above, the reverse tree can be implemented with the following loop:
nodes.zh: 基于上述讨论，反向树可以用下面的循环实现：

nodes.en: The calculation of index is similar to that in the reduction tree phase. The 【1】XY[index+stride] +=XY[index]【/1】 statement reflects the push from the threads’ mapped location into a higher position that is stride away.
nodes.zh: 索引的计算与归约树阶段类似。【1】XY[index+stride] +=XY[index]【/1】这条语句体现了把线程映射位置的值推送到相距一个步长的更高位置。

nodes.en: The final kernel code for a Brent-Kung parallel scan is shown in 【1】Fig. 11.7【/1】. The reader should notice that we never need to have more than 【2】SECTION_SIZE【/2】/2 threads for either the reduction phase or the distribution phase. Therefore we could simply launch a kernel with 【3】SECTION_SIZE【/3】/2 threads in a block. Since we can have up to 1024 threads in a block, each scan section can have up to 2048 elements. However, we will need to have each thread load two X elements at the beginning and store two Y elements at the end.
nodes.zh: Brent-Kung 并行扫描的最终核函数代码见【1】图 11.7【/1】。读者应当注意到，无论归约阶段还是分发阶段，我们都不需要超过【2】SECTION_SIZE【/2】/2 个线程。因此，我们可以直接启动一个每块包含【3】SECTION_SIZE【/3】/2 个线程的核函数。由于线程块最多可以有 1024 个线程，每个扫描段最多可以有 2048 个元素。不过，我们需要让每个线程在开始时加载两个 X 元素，在结束时存储两个 Y 元素。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 11.7【/1】 A Brent-Kung kernel for inclusive (segmented) scan.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 11.7【/1】 用于包含式（分段）扫描的 Brent-Kung 核函数。

nodes.en: As was in the case of the Kogge-Stone scan kernel, one can easily adapt the Brent-Kung inclusive parallel scan kernel into an exclusive scan kernel with a minor adjustment to the statement that loads X elements into XY. Interested readers should also read 【1】Harris et al., 2007【/1】, for an interesting natively exclusive scan kernel that is based on a different way of designing the reverse tree phase of the scan kernel.
nodes.zh: 与 Kogge-Stone 扫描核函数的情况一样，只需对把 X 元素加载到 XY 的语句做一点小调整，就可以把 Brent-Kung 包含式并行扫描核函数改造为排他式扫描核函数。有兴趣的读者还可以阅读【1】Harris et al., 2007【/1】，其中介绍了一种有趣的原生排他式扫描核函数，它基于反向树阶段的一种不同设计方式。

nodes.en: We now turn our attention to the analysis of the number of operations in the reverse tree stage. The number of operations is (16/8)−1+(16/4)−1+(16/2)−1. In general, for 【1】N【/1】 input elements the total number of operations would be (2−1)+(4−1)+…+(【2】N【/2】/4−1)+(【3】N【/3】/2−1), which is 【4】N【/4】−1−log【5】2【/5】(【6】N【/6】). Therefore the total number of operations in the parallel scan, including both the reduction tree (【7】N【/7】−1 operations) and the reverse tree (【8】N【/8】−1−log【9】2【/9】(【10】N【/10】) operations) phases, is 2*【11】N【/11】−2−log【12】2【/12】(【13】N【/13】). Note that the total number of operations is now 【14】O【/14】(【15】N【/15】), as opposed to 【16】O【/16】(【17】N【/17】*log【18】2【/18】【19】N【/19】) for the Kogge-Stone algorithm.

The advantage of the Brent-Kung algorithm over the Kogge-Stone algorithm is quite clear. As the input section becomes bigger, the Brent-Kung algorithm never performs more than 2 times the number of operations performed by the sequential algorithm. In an energy-constrained execution environment the Brent-Kung algorithm strikes a good balance between parallelism and efficiency.
nodes.zh: Brent-Kung 算法相对于 Kogge-Stone 算法的优势相当明显。随着输入段变大，Brent-Kung 算法执行的运算次数从不超过串行算法的两倍。在能量受限的执行环境中，Brent-Kung 算法在并行性与效率之间取得了很好的平衡。

nodes.en: While the Brent-Kung algorithm has a much higher level of theoretical work efficiency than the Kogge-Stone algorithm, its advantage in a CUDA kernel implementation is more limited. Recall that the Brent-Kung algorithm is using 【1】N【/1】/2 threads. The major difference is that the number of active threads drops much faster through the reduction tree than the Kogge-Stone algorithm. However, some of the inactive threads may still consume execution resources in a CUDA device because they are bound to other active threads by SIMD. This makes the advantage in work efficiency of Brent-Kung over Kogge-Stone less drastic in a CUDA device.
nodes.zh: 虽然 Brent-Kung 算法的理论工作效率远高于 Kogge-Stone 算法，但它在 CUDA 核函数实现中的优势较为有限。回顾一下，Brent-Kung 算法使用【1】N【/1】/2 个线程。主要区别在于：在归约树中，活跃线程数量的下降比 Kogge-Stone 算法快得多。然而，在 CUDA 设备中，一些非活跃线程仍可能消耗执行资源，因为它们通过 SIMD 与活跃线程绑定在一起。这使得 Brent-Kung 相对于 Kogge-Stone 在工作效率上的优势在 CUDA 设备上不那么显著。

nodes.en: The main disadvantage of Brent-Kung over Kogge-Stone is its potentially longer execution time despite its higher work efficiency. With infinite execution resources, Brent-Kung should take about twice as long as Kogge-Stone, owing to the need for additional steps to perform the reverse tree phase. However, the speed comparison can be quite different when we have limited execution resources. Using the example in 【1】Section 11.3【/1】, if we process 1024 input elements with 32 execution units, the Brent-Kung kernel is expected to take approximately (2*1024−2−10)/32=63.6 steps. The reader should verify that with control divergence there will be about five more steps when the total number of active threads drops below 32 in each phase. This results in a speedup of 1024/73.6=14 over sequential execution. This is in comparison with the 320 time units and speedup of 3.2 for Kogge-Stone. The comparison would be to Kogge-Stone’s advantage, of course, when there are many more execution resources and/or when the latencies are much longer.
nodes.zh: Brent-Kung 相对于 Kogge-Stone 的主要缺点是：尽管工作效率更高，但它的执行时间可能更长。在执行资源无限的情况下，由于反向树阶段需要额外的步数，Brent-Kung 的耗时大约是 Kogge-Stone 的两倍。然而，当执行资源有限时，速度比较的结果可能大不相同。以【1】第 11.3 节【/1】中的例子来说，如果用 32 个执行单元处理 1024 个输入元素，Brent-Kung 核函数预计大约需要 (2*1024−2−10)/32=63.6 步。读者可以验证，考虑到控制发散，当每个阶段活跃线程总数降到 32 以下时，还会多出大约五步。这相对串行执行获得了 1024/73.6=14 的加速比。与之相比，Kogge-Stone 是 320 个时间单位和 3.2 的加速比。当然，当执行资源多得多和/或延迟长得多时，比较结果将有利于 Kogge-Stone。

nodes.en: 11.5 Coarsening for even more work efficiency
nodes.zh: 11.5 进一步提升工作效率的粗化

nodes.en: The overhead of parallelizing scan across multiple threads is like reduction in that it includes the hardware underutilization and synchronization overhead of the tree execution pattern. However, scan has an additional parallelization overhead, and that is reduced work efficiency. As we have seen, parallel scan is less work efficient than sequential scan. This lower work efficiency is an acceptable price to pay to parallelize if the threads were actually to run in parallel. However, if the hardware were to serialize them, we would be better off serializing them ourselves via thread coarsening to improve work efficiency.
nodes.zh: 跨多个线程并行化扫描的开销与归约类似，都包括树形执行模式带来的硬件未被充分利用和同步开销。不过，扫描还有一项额外的并行化开销，那就是工作效率下降。正如我们所见，并行扫描的工作效率不如串行扫描。如果线程确实会并行运行，那么为了并行化而付出工作效率降低的代价是可以接受的。然而，如果硬件会串行化这些线程，我们还不如自己通过线程粗化将它们串行化，以提高工作效率。

nodes.en: We can design a parallel segmented scan algorithm that achieves even better work efficiency by adding a phase of fully independent sequential scans on subsections of the input. Each thread block receives a section of the input that is larger than the original section by the coarsening factor. At the beginning of the algorithm we partition the block’s section of the input into multiple contiguous subsections: one for each thread. The number of subsections is the same as the number of threads in the thread block.
nodes.zh: 我们可以设计一种并行分段扫描算法，通过增加一个阶段——在输入的各子段上执行完全独立的串行扫描——来获得更好的工作效率。每个线程块收到的输入段比原来的段大一个粗化因子。算法开始时，我们把线程块负责的输入段划分为多个连续子段：每个线程一个。子段的数量与线程块中的线程数相同。

nodes.en: The coarsened scan is divided into three phases as shown in 【1】Fig. 11.8【/1】. During the first phase, we have each thread perform a sequential scan on its contiguous subsection. For example, in 【2】Fig. 11.8【/2】 we assume that there are four threads in a block. We partition the 16-element input section into four subsections with four elements each. Thread 0 will perform scan on its section (2, 1, 3, 1) and generate (2, 3, 6, 7). Thread 1 will perform scan on its section (0, 4, 1, 2) and generate (0, 4, 5, 7), and so on.
nodes.zh: 如【1】图 11.8【/1】所示，粗化的扫描分为三个阶段。第一阶段，我们让每个线程在自己的连续子段上执行一次串行扫描。例如，在【2】图 11.8【/2】中，我们假设线程块内有四个线程。我们把 16 个元素的输入段划分为四个子段，每个子段四个元素。线程 0 将对其子段 (2, 1, 3, 1) 执行扫描并生成 (2, 3, 6, 7)。线程 1 将对其子段 (0, 4, 1, 2) 执行扫描并生成 (0, 4, 5, 7)，依此类推。

nodes.en: 【1】Figure 11.8【/1】 A three-phase parallel scan for higher work efficiency.
nodes.zh: 【1】图 11.8【/1】 为获得更高工作效率的三阶段并行扫描。

nodes.en: Note that if each thread directly performs scan by accessing the input from global memory, their accesses would not be coalesced. For example, during the first iteration, thread 0 would be accessing input element 0, thread 1 would be accessing input element 4, and so on. Therefore we improve memory coalescing by using shared memory to absorb the memory accesses that cannot be coalesced, as was mentioned in 【1】Chapter 6【/1】, Performance Considerations. That is, we transfer data between shared memory and global memory in a coalesced manner and perform the memory accesses with the unfavorable access pattern in shared memory. At the beginning of the first phase, all threads collaborate to load the input into the shared memory in an iterative manner. In each iteration, adjacent threads load adjacent elements to enable memory coalescing. For example, in 【2】Fig. 11.8【/2】 we have all threads collaborate and load four elements in a coalesced manner: Thread 0 loads element 0, thread 1 loads element 1, and so on. All threads then move to load the next four elements: Thread 0 loads element 4, thread 1 loads element 5, and so on.
nodes.zh: 请注意，如果每个线程直接通过访问全局内存来执行扫描，它们的访问将不是合并的。例如，在第一次迭代中，线程 0 将访问输入元素 0，线程 1 将访问输入元素 4，依此类推。因此，我们利用共享内存来吸收无法合并的内存访问，从而改善内存合并，正如【1】第 6 章【/1】性能考量中所提到的。也就是说，我们在共享内存与全局内存之间以合并方式传输数据，而在共享内存中执行具有不利访问模式的内存访问。第一阶段开始时，所有线程协作以迭代方式把输入加载到共享内存中。每次迭代中，相邻线程加载相邻元素，以实现内存合并。例如，在【2】图 11.8【/2】中，我们让所有线程协作以合并方式加载四个元素：线程 0 加载元素 0，线程 1 加载元素 1，依此类推。然后所有线程继续加载接下来的四个元素：线程 0 加载元素 4，线程 1 加载元素 5，依此类推。

nodes.en: Once all input elements are in the shared memory, the threads access their own subsection from the shared memory and perform a sequential scan on it. This is shown as Phase 1 in 【1】Fig. 11.8【/1】. Note that at the end of Phase 1 the last element of each section (highlighted as black in the second row) contains the sum of all input elements in the section. For example, the last element of section 0 contains value 7, the sum of the input elements (2, 1, 3, 1) in the section.
nodes.zh: 一旦所有输入元素都进入共享内存，线程就从共享内存访问各自的子段并执行串行扫描。这在【1】图 11.8【/1】中显示为阶段 1。请注意，阶段 1 结束时，每个子段的最后一个元素（在第二行中以黑色突出显示）包含该段所有输入元素的和。例如，段 0 的最后一个元素包含值 7，即该段输入元素 (2, 1, 3, 1) 的和。

nodes.en: During the second phase, all threads in each block collaborate and perform a scan operation on a logical array that consists of the last element of each section. This can be done with a Kogge-Stone or Brent-Kung algorithm, since there are only a modest number of elements (number of threads in a block). Note that the thread-to-element mappings need to be slightly modified from those in 【1】Figs. 11.3【/1】 and 【2】11.7【/2】, since the elements that need to be scanned are of stride (four elements in 【3】Fig. 11.8【/3】) distance away from each other.
nodes.zh: 在第二阶段，每个线程块中的所有线程协作，对由每个子段最后一个元素组成的逻辑数组执行一次扫描运算。由于元素数量不多（即线程块中的线程数），可以用 Kogge-Stone 或 Brent-Kung 算法完成。请注意，线程到元素的映射需要相对【1】图 11.3【/1】和图【2】11.7【/2】稍作修改，因为需要扫描的元素彼此相距一个步长（在【3】图 11.8【/3】中是四个元素）。
